explicit_validation.explanation: Paper explicitly compares LLM-as-a-judge (Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct) with human evaluation on the same 50 model responses, reporting Cohen's kappa agreement metrics

prompts.notes: Full prompt provided in Appendix C.1 with detailed classification instructions and examples for CLASS A/B/C responses; uses Chain-of-Thought reasoning

guidelines.notes: Classification scheme detailed in main text with CLASS A/Explicit (acknowledge ambiguity), CLASS B/Implicit (describe one referent with attributes), CLASS C/High Risk (assume one referent without clarification); Appendix C.1 shows annotation examples

sample_size.notes: 50 model responses randomly sampled from Section 4.1 models and annotated by both LLM and human evaluators

quantitative_scores.notes: Agreement between human annotators and Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct output

validation_results.summary_finding: LLM shows very high agreement with human annotation (κ=0.94 vs human-human κ=0.97), validating Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct as reliable automatic evaluator for response classification

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM and human evaluate the same three response categories; additional LLM-only analysis for CoT reasoning steps; human-only validation for sensitive RAcQUET-BIAS stereotypes evaluation
